events.title: How I AI
events.description:
Not sure where AI fits into your work? Not sure it’s worth your time?

Join us ***online*** Wednesday, Nov. 11, from 12 to 1 PM for “How I AI,” a show-and-tell panel. Three practitioners will show how they use AI in their jobs. You’ll see real workflows, not hype.

This is a **virtual-only event on Google Meet**. We’ll record the session and post the recording on our YouTube channel.

**Who you’ll hear from**

* **Desarae Veit**, State Manager with the State of Iowa, who spent the last 2.5 years as a Capture Manager at General Dynamics Information Technology and is actively pursuing her PhD in HCI.
* **Sarah Heilman**, Senior User Experience Designer at Workiva, who has spent 7+ years designing B2B SaaS platforms.
* **Kathryn Downing**, Sr. Product Designer at Tractor Zoom, who also previously led UX teams at Hy-Vee, Shopify, and Gap, Inc.

**How it works**
Each presenter gets 10 minutes to show how they use AI. We’ll stop for Q&A after each demo, then move to the next person.

**Who it’s for**
Anyone who’s unsure how to use AI day to day, or what value it adds. Come with questions.
